title: ראה
content:
[Str7200] ראה (√ of foll.; not Aram.; BH רָאָה see).

[Str7299] † [רֵו] n.m. appearance (Targum, rare);—sf. רֵוֵהּ Dn 2:31, 3:25.

[Str7217,7218] † רֵאשׁ n.m.:Dn 7:6 head (Eg. Aram., S-CPap.; Palm. רש; Targum רֵישׁ, Syr. ܪܝܫ; BH ראֹשׁ);—cstr. ´ר: Dn 7:1; emph. הָ֯ 2:38; sf. רֵאשׁי 4:2 +, חָ֯ 2:28, הֵּ֯ v:32 +, הַּ֯ 7:20, הֵ֯וֺן 3:27; pl. abs. רֵאשִׁין 7:6, sf. רָאשֵׁיהֹם (K§§ 53, Anm. b); 63 GuHpt ad loc.) Ezr 5:10; —

1. head of man Dn 3:27, cf. 7:9; in vision: of image 2:32, 2:38, beast 7:6, 7:20. 2. head as seat of visions, הֶזְוֵי רֵאשָׁךְ, etc., 2:28, 4:2, 4:7, 4:10, 7:1, 7:15. 3. = chief, ´בְּר: Ezr 5:10 in the capacity of their chiefs. 4. sum, essential content, of matters Dn 7:1 (NesMM 40 beginning).

title: רבב
content:
[Str7227,7231,7239] רבב (√ of foll.; v. BH I. רבב, רַב, רִבּוֺ).

[Str7229,7260] רַב adj. great (Targum Syr.);—abs. Dn 2:31 +, cstr. v:14 +; emph. m. רַבָּא Ezr 4:10 +; f. רַבְּתָא Dn 4:27; .mpl. redupl. רַבְרְבִין (K§ 59, 4) 3:33, fpl. בָן- 2:48 +, emph. ָ֯ תָא 7:11, 7:17;—l. great, lit., of image Dn 2:31, rock v:35, city 4:27, sea 7:2, beast v:3, v:17, teeth v:7, gifts 2:48; great, imposing, feast 5:1, signs 3:33, words 7:8, 7:11, 7:20; c. מִן comp. 7:20. 2. fig. of power, influence, etc.: great king 2:10, Ezr 4:10, 5:11 (cf. Zinj. מלכן רברבן Cooke183), God 5:8, Dn 2:45. 3. as n. = captain, chief: רַב טַבָּחַיָּא Dn 2:14, סִגְנִין ´ר: v:48, חַרְטֻמַּיָּא ´ר: 4:6, 5:11.

[Str7240] † רִבּוֺ (K§ 65, 4) n.f. myriad (Targum Syr.);—abs. ´ר: + pl. רבון Kt (rd. רִבְּיָן K1. c.), רִבְבָן Qr Dn 7:10 a myriad myriads.

[Str7261] † [רַבְרְבָן] n.m. lord, noble (cf. Targum Syr.);—pl. sf. רַבְרְבָנַי Dn 4:33 my lords (of Neb.); נ֫וֺהִי- (of Belshazzar) 5:1, 5:2, 5:3, 5:9, 5:10, of Darius 6:18; ניך- Kt, נָח- Qr (K§ 53, Anm. b)) of Belshazzar v:23.

title: רְבָה
content:
[Str7236,7235] † רְבָה vb. grow great (Targum Syr.; v. BH I. רבה);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´ר: Dn 4:8 +; 3 fs. רְבָת v:19; 2 ms. רְבַיְתָ Kt ( > רְבַת Qr K§ 47, Beisp. 1)a)) v:19;—grow tall and large, of tree Dn 4:8, 4:17; grow long, of hair v:30; fig. grow great, of king v:19, increase, of greatness v:19. Pa. make great: Pf. 3 ms. רַבִּי 2:48 c. ל acc. Pers.

[Str7238] † רְבוּ n.f. greatness (Targum Syr.);—abs. ´ר: Dn 4:33, emph. רְבוּתָא 5:18 +, sf. תָךְ- 4:19;—greatness of king Dn 4:19, 4:33, 5:18, 5:19; of kingdom 7:27.

title: רבע
content:
[Str702,7243] רבע (v. BH אַרְבַּע, רְבִיעִי, √ רבע).

[Str703] † אַרְבַּע, אַרְבְּעָה n.m. et f. four;— 1. m.: bef. n. fpl. Dn 7:2, 7:3; n. fs. מְאָה ´א: Ezr 6:17; after n. fpl. Dn 7:6; as pred. אַרְבַָּע v:17. 2. f.: bef. n. mpl. Dn 7:6, 7:16; after n. mpl. 3:25.

[Str7244] † [רְבִיעִי] adj. num. ord. fourth;—f. abs. רביעיא Kt, רְבִיעָאָה Qr (K§ 66 ,1) Dn 2:40, 3:25, 7:7, 7:23; emph. רְבִיעָֽיְתָא v:19, v:23.

[Str7229,7260–61] רַבְרְבִין etc. v. רַב supr. רַבְרְבָן v. רבב.

title: רְגַז
content:
[Str7264–65] † [רְגַז] vb. Haph. enrage (cf. BH);—Pf. 3 mpl. הַרְגִּ֫זוּ Ezr 5:12, c. acc. לָאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא.

[Str7266] † רְּגַז n.m. rage;—abs. Dn 3:13 (of king).

[Str7271–72] † [רְגַל] n.[f.] foot (v. BH);—du. abs. רַגְלַ֫יִן Dn 7:4; emph. לַיָּא- 2:41, 2:42; sf. לוֺ֫הִי- v:33, v:34, רגליה Kt, רְגַלַהּ Qr (K§ 53, 2, Anm. b)) 7:7, 7:19;—feet; in vision, of image Dn 2:33, 2:34, 2:41, 2:42, of beast 7:4, 7:7, 7:19.

title: רְגַשׁ
content:
[Str7284,7283] † [רְגַשׁ] vb. be in tumult (Targum; Syr. (rare; usu. feel, perceive); v. BH (late, rare));—Haph. shew tumultuousness, come thronging: Pf. 3 mpl. הַרְגִּ֫שׁוּ, c. עַל Pers. Dn 6:7, 6:16, abs. v:12.

[Str7299] רֵוֵהּ v. [רֵו] sub ראה. above

title: רוח
content:
[Str7307,7381] רוח (√ of foll.; v. BH id., רוּח, רֵיחַ).

[Str7308] † רוּחַ n.f.:Dn 5:12 wind, spirit;—´ר: abs. Dn 5:12, 6:4, cstr. 4:5 +, emph. רוּחָא 2:35; sf. רוּחִי 7:15, הֵּ֯ 5:20; pl. cstr. רוּחֵי 7:2;—1. wind Dn 2:35, 7:2. 2. spirit: a. of man, 5:20, 7:15; as faculty of knowledge, יַתִּירא ´ר: 5:12, 6:4. b. אֱלָהִין קַדִּישִׁין ´ר: 4:5, 4:6, 4:15, 5:11, ´א :´ר: v:14.

[Str7382] † רֵיחַ n.f. smell;—cstr. נוּר ´ר: Dn 3:27.

title: רוּם
content:
[Str7311,7313] † [רוּם] vb. rise (v. BH);—Pe. Pt. pass. רִם Dn 5:20 lifted up, of heart, i.e. presumptuous. Pō‘l. extol: Pt. מְרוֺמֵם 4:34 (ל dei). Haph. exalt: Pt. מָרִים 5:19 (acc. Pers.). .Hithpō‘l. lift oneself up against, 5:23 (עַל dei).

[Str7314] † [רוּם] n.m. :Dn 4:7 height;—sf. רוּמֵהּ, of temple Ezr 6:3, image Dn 3:1, tree in vision 4:7, 4:8, 4:17.

[Str7328] † רָז n.m.:Dn 2:18 secret (Targum id., Syr. ܪܙ, ܐܪܙ, ܪܐܙܐ; Pers. loan-word; = Phlv. rāž, N Pers. rāz AndrM 83 *);—abs. ´ר: Dn 4:6, emph. רָזָא 2:18, 2:19, 2:27, 2:30, 2:47; pl. abs. רָזִין v:28, v:47, emph. רָזַיָּא v:29.

[Str7348,7348] רְחוּם n.pr.m. Persian official Ezr 4:8 (usu. expl. from √ רחם, v. BH, p. 933; Scheft92 thinks poss. orig. רוחם, OIran. n.pr. rukma, = splendour).

[Str7359,7356] רַחֲמִין n.[m.] pl. intens. compassion (BH רַחֲמִים, √ I. רחם);—abs. ´ר: Dn 2:18.

title: רְחַץ
content: [Str7365] † [רְחַץ] vb. (Targum id., Chr-Pal. ܪܚܨ SchwallyIdiot, 126 SchulthLex. 193; As. raḫâṣu; Ar. رَخُصَ II. have indulgence, permission);—Hithpe. set one's trust upon (עַל dei) Pf. 3 mpl. הִתְרְחִ֫צוּ Dn 3:28.

title: רחק
content:
[Str7350,7368] רחק (√ of following; v. BH רחק, רָחוֺק).

[Str7352] † [רְחִיק] adj. far;—pl. abs. רְחִיקִין הֲווֺ מִן־תַּמָּה Ezr 6:6, i.e. keep aloof.

[Str7382] רֵיחַ v. רוח

title: רְמָא
content: [Str7411–12] † [רְמָא] vb. cast, throw (v. BH I. רמךְ (rare));—Pe. Pf. 3 mpl. רְמוֺ Dn 6:17, 6:25; 1 pl. רְמֵ֫ינָא 3:24; Inf. לְמִרְמֵא v:20, Ezr 7:24);—1. cast, acc. Pers. + ל loc. Dn 3:24, 6:25; acc. Pers. om. v:17; 3:20. 2. fig. throw (burden of) tribute, עַל Pers., Ezr 7:24. Pe‘îl Pf. 3 mpl. רְמִיו (WCG 225): 1. were cast, subj. Pers. c. ל loc., Dn 3:21. 2. were placed, set, 7:9 (cf. Targum Je 1:15 Dr, and BH ירח 2). Hithpe. be cast, subj. Pers. c. ל loc.: Impf. 3 ms. יִתְרְמֵא Dn 3:6, 3:11, 6:8, 6:13; 2 mpl. תִּתְרְמוֺן 3:15.

title: רעה
content:
[Str7462] רעה (√ of following; cf. BH III. רעה).

[Str7470] [רְעוּ] n.f. good pleasure, will;—cstr. רְעוּת of king Ezr 5:17, of God 7:18.

[Str7476] † [רַעְיוֺן] n.m.:Dn 4:16 thought;—pl, cstr. רַעְיוֺנֵי לִבְבָךְ Dn 2:30; sf. נַי- 7:28; ניך- Kt, נָח- Qr (K§ 53 Anm. b)) 2:29, 5:10, רַעְיֹנֹ֫הִי 4:16, 5:6.

[Str7487,7488] † רַעֲנַן adj. flourishing (perh. loan-word from BH רַעֲנָן luxuriant, √ רען);—fig. of Pers. Dn 4:1 (cf. BH Psalm 92:15).

title: רְעַע
content: [Str7490] † [רְעַע] vb. crush, shatter (Targum Syr.; v. BH רצץ);—Pe. Impf. 3 fs. תֵרֹעַ(וְ) Dn 2:40 (obj. om.). Pa. Pt. act. מִרָעַע 2:40 (acc. rei).

title: רְפַס
content: [Str7511–12] † [רְפַס] vb. tread, trample (cf. BH (late));—Pe. Pt. act. fs. בּרגיה רָֽסְפָה, c. acc. rei Dn 7:7, 7:19.

title: רְשַׁם
content:
[Str7559–60] † רְשַׁם vb. inscribe, sign (Targum Syr,; v. BH (once, late));—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´ר: Dn 6:10; 2 ms. רְשַׁ֫מְתָּ v:13; רְשַָׁמְתָּ v:14; Impf. 2 ms. תִרְשֻׁם(וְ) v:9;—inscribe (prob. with one’s name, i.e.) sign, acc. כְּתָבָא Dn 6:9, 6:10, אֱסָר v:13, v:14. Pe‘îl Pf. 3 ms. רְשִׁים, subj. כְּתָבא: 1. be inscribed, written, Dn 5:24, 5:25. 2. be signed 6:11.

[Str5443,7639] † שַבְּכָא ( > van d. H. ´ס:, v. Baer) n.[m.] trigon, mus. instr. (whence prob. Gk. σαμβύκη, triang. instr. with (four strings, v. Thes LewyFremdw. 161 f. PrinceEB 3238 Dr:Dn 3:5; also BH שֽבָכָה lattice-work, √ שבך, cf. Syr. ܣܒܟ);—Dn 3:5, 3:7, 3:10, 3:15.
